scope: 581 distinct context-bound concepts each in Czech/Hungarian;1162 authored meanings. AUTHOR_DRAFT_NOT_REVIEWED.
hashMethod: sha256 UTF-8 compact sorted JSON {source,englishTargets}, matching catalog rather than source-only SHA
checks: Coverage exactly0..580 for each language, split300+281
Exact schema/sourceHash/role localized_meaning; atomic file saves
All source digits/placeholders and grammatical ~ markers preserved
No Hangul fallback; no translation exactly repeats an English target
Each Korean source/EnglishTargets/reference row inspected; catalog keys remain context identifiers, and conflicting references were ignored in favor of Korean+target

policy.unknownEntities: Dictionary meanings, no new fictional characters or named entity settings. Existing gender and number unknowns remain unknown.
policy.grammaticalGender: Czech dictionary adjective/noun gender is grammatical, not a fictional person setting. Person definitions used where practical. Explicit daughter/son/sister/brother/mother/father/queen meanings retain source lexical gender.
policy.synonyms: Separate indices are not forced to have non-overlapping meanings. Synonym choices causing multiple correct answers must be held at the question/source level, not repaired by invention.
policy.questionValidation: This is a concept catalog, not complete instantiated question sets; no question answer-uniqueness approval or collision-free claim.

limitations: Authored and self-checked only; independent semantic/native/teacher review required.
Polysemy/register and idiomatic definitions need contextual review against actual question uses before publication.
SourceReferenceIssues record defects without editing the frozen catalog.
